notes: The mechanic is a grant-budget component on the universe handle plus a legality-mask edge. An absent row means unbounded, which is what every save and every hand-built test world written before it carries, so nothing that worked stops working. WORLD_SCHEMA_VERSION moved 4 to 5; sim-core's SNAPSHOT_VERSION did not move and no golden fixture diffs — goldens:regen was never run.

Measured separately in tools/w69: no strategy in this pool submits action 8 even with an unbounded budget. archivist sees the mask open on 497 of 4804 ticks and is closed by affordability on the other 4307; narrow-depth sees it open on 2630 of 3453 and asks zero times because an earlier preference is always legal. A budget cannot bind a verb nobody spends, which is why these deltas being exactly zero is expected rather than surprising.
Not a balance claim. release-plan.md forbids one before 0.5.0 and this file makes none: it is a measurement of one build, re-recorded because the content revision moved beneath it.
rationale: Provenance only. No rule changed and no metric moved for any run this sweep executes. contentRevision moved from 2512ea02d2a7569d8d0bacc4c5a926ca to cd47722ed6fa0a8b3627c6f63fded6f3 because the founding-grant budget added three god constants (founding-grant-budget-start, founding-grant-accrual-nodes, founding-grant-budget-cap), and the gate is right that a delta across two content revisions is a category error. It is also right that this one is not a behaviour change: this is the one gate of the three whose pool plays a god verb that grants, so its deltas are the ones worth reading, and run against the superseded baseline first every one of its ten metrics read delta 0.00000 at 0.00 SE — exactly zero, not merely inside tolerance. The three constants ship at values no run can reach, because the grid holds 300 nodes and only prerequisite-free ones in permitted cells are grantable, so god action 8 behaves at this build exactly as it always has and the budget is exercised only through swept arms that name it. Precedent for a provenance-only re-record: 0bf8437 and 7f46277.
